title: EverHaven
description: A zero monetization community server for builders who want a small quaint community with QOL plugins and features to enhance the Minecraft experience.
body:
We're a small, long-term community server and we're totally fine with that. The world never resets, your builds stay forever, and we expand the borders when new updates drop. There's no monetization. No ranks for sale, no crates, no store. This is a passion project, self-hosted on personal hardware, so there's no monthly bill keeping us up at night. We're not trying to be the biggest server out there. We just want a solid place to build and hang out.

# What to expect:

The server is family-friendly. Kindness and patience aren't optional. We run weekly content updates and community events to keep things fresh. We have a robust rank system built around actual progression, so you always feel like you're working toward something. Every reward is earned through playtime, no purchase required. We support Java & Bedrock crossplay, custom furniture & decor, earnable flight within your claims, a player-driven economy with shopkeepers, and play-to-earn cosmetics.

# Features at a glance:

- Player-run shops, economy & auction house
- Custom mobs & pets
- Custom furniture & models
- Custom enchantments
- Skill leveling system (AuraSkills)
- Clue scrolls & daily activities
- Live dynmap
